answer: An agent registry where every identity must post a small refundable stake and accumulate a reputation thread. A user, like an old sonnet composer, earns standing by writing verified work over time; the grove of peers cross-checks each new claim against that thread, so reputation compounds slowly through real contributions. Forging one fresh identity per attack costs the full stake plus the waiting period. Attacker's real bottleneck: capital and time scale linearly with every fake node, while honest grove members flag shallow threads fast.
